matrix_meaning: SGamut3Cine linear (S-Log3 decoded) -> white-balanced A7M5 camera RGB, normalised so equal RGB maps to equal RGB
exposure_scale_meaning: photo camera RGB (Sony native / 16384) per unit S-Log3 scene reflection, valid when both shots used the same ISO/aperture/shutter
white_balance_difference_meaning: photo / video per-channel gain on neutrals (mean 1); removed from the matrix
sony_scale_meaning: Sony native photo camera value per unit S-Log3 scene reflection at equal nominal ISO x shutter x aperture (photo ISO vs S-Log3 ISO rating, i.e. both metered at 0). Geometric mean of four pairs normalised by the recorded settings; spread 0.14 EV, sd 0.056 EV
exposure_settings_source: photo EXIF; video Sony rtmd stream (0x8000 FNumber, 0x8109 ExposureTime, 0x810b ISO, 0x810e colour temperature)
